products.short_description: Cleanly retire the old Microsoft 365 tenant after the Google move — completeness verification, data disposition + legal-hold handling, licensing wind-down, identity/app cleanup, DNS/integration cutover, and formal closure — an auditable exit. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Cleanly retire the Microsoft 365 tenant after the move to Google

Once users are live on Google Workspace, the old Microsoft 365 tenant is cost, risk, and orphaned data — but pulling the plug carelessly loses records or breaks lingering integrations. This solution is the decommission & retirement runbook: verify migration completeness, handle data disposition and legal-hold/eDiscovery obligations, wind down licensing and Entra app registrations, re-point or remove DNS/integrations, and formally close the tenant — a clean, auditable exit.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the retirement model: completeness verification, data disposition vs retention/legal hold, licensing wind-down, identity/app cleanup, DNS/integration cutover, and formal closure.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (migration signed off, M365/Entra admin access, legal/records stakeholders, DNS control).
  • Implementation Guide — verify completeness, export/dispose data under the retention policy, decommission licensing + Entra app registrations, re-point/remove DNS + integrations, and execute formal tenant closure — staged with rollback windows.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (nothing orphaned, obligations met, closure evidenced) plus Best Practices for a clean, auditable exit; legal-hold determinations deferred to legal/records.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The retired Microsoft 365 tenant closed cleanly and auditably — nothing orphaned, records obligations met, licensing and identity wound down — the cost and risk gone for good.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • decommission_report.py — pre-closure guardrail check + closure evidence pack (read-only)
    • inventory_app_and_orphans.py — inventory Entra apps/SPs/credentials + orphaned identities (read-only)
    • license_winddown_helper.py — model and reclaim M365 license assignments (dry-run by default)
    • map_dns_integration.py — map & classify each domain's DNS + integration ties to the M365 tenant (read-only)
    • verify_migration_completeness.py — reconcile M365 residuals against a migration baseline (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
